comment: Slice flora and rocks from Meshy (decision 2026-11-12: organic objects via AI 3D + Blender). Read by tools/ki3d/meshy_generate.py and tools/blender/process_ki3d.py. One preview (shape) per asset; every refine gives a textured state of the same shape. size_cm: target height (or longest side with size_axis 'longest'). tris: Meshy target_polycount.
style_prompt: Stylized 3D game asset for a Nordic early medieval survival game. Clean readable silhouette, broad simple shapes, moderate detail, natural colors. Single object standing upright, no pedestal, no base plate, no text.
texture_style: Hand-painted stylized texture, soft natural colors, even lighting, no baked dark shadows.

assets.prompt: A Scots pine tree: tall straight trunk with orange-red flaky bark on the upper part and grey-brown bark at the base, a few bare lower branch stubs, a flattish irregular crown of dark green needle clusters at the top.

states.full: Scots pine with orange-red upper bark, grey-brown lower bark, dark green needles.

assets.prompt: A freshly cut Scots pine tree stump, flat cut top showing pale wood and growth rings, reddish-brown bark, a few thick roots spreading into the ground.

states.full: Pale freshly cut wood with growth rings on top, reddish-brown bark.

assets.prompt: A silver birch tree: slender white trunk with black horizontal marks and dark rough bark near the base, thin drooping branches, a light airy crown of small bright green leaves.

states.full: White birch bark with black marks, bright fresh green leaves.

assets.prompt: A freshly cut silver birch tree stump, flat cut top showing pale wood and growth rings, white bark with black marks, short roots.

states.full: Pale freshly cut wood on top, white birch bark with black marks.

assets.prompt: A wild crab apple tree: short gnarled slightly leaning trunk, twisted branches, a small dense rounded crown of green leaves, many small round apples hanging in the crown.

states.full: Dark gnarled bark, green leaves, many small yellow and red apples clearly visible in the crown.
states.picked: Dark gnarled bark, only green leaves, no fruit at all.

assets.prompt: A low wild raspberry bush, a dense mass of arching leafy green canes, clusters of small round berries.

states.full: Green leaves and canes, many ripe red raspberries clearly visible.
states.picked: Green leaves and canes only, no berries.

assets.prompt: A common hazel shrub: many thin straight stems growing from one base, broad rounded leaves, small clusters of hazelnuts.

states.full: Grey-brown stems, fresh green leaves, clusters of light brown hazelnuts in green husks clearly visible.
states.picked: Grey-brown stems and fresh green leaves only, no nuts.

assets.prompt: A small patch of mossy forest floor with a cluster of porcini mushrooms with brown caps and a few golden chanterelles.

states.full: Brown porcini caps with pale stems, golden yellow chanterelles, green moss.

assets.prompt: A small loose pile of three or four fist-sized grey field stones.

states.full: Grey and beige field stones, slightly rounded.

assets.prompt: A few dry fallen tree branches lying flat on the ground, grey-brown bark, some small twigs.

states.full: Dry grey-brown bark, pale broken ends.

assets.prompt: A clump of stinging nettle plants: upright stems with pairs of serrated pointed dark green leaves.

states.full: Dark green serrated nettle leaves, green stems.

assets.prompt: A clump of short freshly cut stinging nettle stems close to the ground, a few small leaves left.

states.full: Green cut stems, a few small dark green leaves.

assets.prompt: A small rounded grey granite boulder with a few lichen spots.

states.full: Grey granite with fine speckles, pale lichen spots.

assets.prompt: A medium-sized angular grey granite rock with a few cracks and patches of green moss.

states.full: Grey granite with fine speckles, green moss patches.

assets.prompt: A large weathered grey granite boulder, a glacial erratic with rounded edges, moss on top and lichen spots.

states.full: Weathered grey granite, green moss on top, pale lichen spots.

assets.prompt: A low flat pile of broken grey granite rubble and stone chips.

states.full: Grey granite chips, fresh lighter broken faces.
